title: General Manager-Civil & Utilities Construction
description:
About the Company

The company is a privately held, nationally recognized utility contractor with more than 100 years of history. They are one of the few firms in the industry that fully self-performs all aspects of open-cut and specialty pipe rehabilitation.

The company operates across key U.S. markets including California, Maryland, and Washington, D.C. and are known for thier technical expertise, disciplined execution, strong safety culture, and long-standing client relationships across the public utility and infrastructure sectors.

About the Position

The General Manager (GM) serves as the senior leader for the company's California Region, with full P&L responsibility and accountability for all aspects of regional performance. This role is responsible for driving safety, operational excellence, financial results, talent development, client satisfaction, and strategic growth.

Reporting into corporate leadership, the SVP/GM acts as the primary executive representative for the region—aligning regional strategy with corporate objectives while building a high-performing, accountable leadership team. Success in this role requires strong business judgment, deep operational expertise in civil and utility construction, and the ability to lead complex organizations through growth.

Key Responsibilities

Regional & Business Leadership

  • Provide overall leadership, direction, and accountability for all regional operations and business functions
  • Develop and execute regional business plans aligned with corporate strategy and long-term growth objectives
  • Serve as the senior company representative with clients, partners, regulators, and internal stakeholders
  • Champion company culture, values, and a strong commitment to safety, ethics, and operational excellence

Operational Oversight

  • Oversee the planning, execution, and delivery of multiple civil and utility construction projects
  • Ensure projects meet standards for safety, quality, schedule, and profitability
  • Establish performance expectations and conduct regular operational and project reviews
  • Drive continuous improvement across operations, processes, and resource utilization

Financial Management & P&L Accountability

  • Maintain full responsibility for regional financial performance including revenue, margin, overhead, and cash flow
  • Review and approve budgets, forecasts, and financial plans
  • Analyze financial results, identify risks and opportunities, and implement corrective actions
  • Prepare and present financial performance reports to senior leadership

Contract, Risk & Compliance Management

  • Ensure compliance with contractual, legal, and regulatory requirements
  • Oversee contract negotiations, change management, claims, and dispute resolution
  • Proactively identify and mitigate operational, financial, and contractual risks

Safety & Quality Leadership

  • Lead a safety-first culture and ensure compliance with OSHA, company, and client requirements
  • Hold leadership teams accountable for safety and quality outcomes
  • Promote continuous improvement in safety performance and execution quality

Team Leadership & Talent Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop regional leadership including project managers, superintendents, and support teams
  • Support recruiting, onboarding, performance management, and succession planning
  • Build a collaborative, accountable, and high-performing regional organization
  • Encourage professional development and retention of top talent

Business Development & Client Relations

  • Drive regional growth through new market opportunities and expanded client relationships
  • Partner with business development teams on pursuit strategy, proposals, and interviews
  • Strengthen relationships with owners, utilities, subcontractors, vendors, and regulatory agencies
  • Ensure high levels of client satisfaction and repeat business

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Business, or related field (preferred)
  • Extensive senior leadership experience in civil and utility construction
  • Proven success leading a region or business unit with full P&L responsibility
  • Strong understanding of the California construction market and regulatory environment
  • Demonstrated financial expertise in budgeting, forecasting, cost control, and performance analysis
  • Ability to interpret construction drawings, specifications, and contract documents
  • Exceptional leadership, decision-making, and problem-solving skills
  • Strong executive-level communication and stakeholder management abilities
  • Willingness to travel and work extended hours as required
  • Highly organized, results-driven, and capable of managing complex, competing priorities

Benefits

  • Competitive executive-level compensation package
  • Performance-based incentives tied to regional results
  • Opportunity to lead a major region for a respected, privately held national contractor
  • Long-term career growth and influence within a stable, values-driven organization
  • Comprehensive benefits package

title: Senior Estimator-General Construction
description:
Cost Estimator

About the Company

The company is a leading player in the construction industry, recognized for its work on high-profile infrastructure and aviation mega projects. With a deep commitment to innovation, quality, and collaborative project delivery, the company partners with public and private sector clients to deliver complex projects using cutting-edge methods such as Progressive Design-Build and CMAR (Construction Manager at Risk).

About the Position

The company is seeking an experienced Senior Estimator to support team. This role is ideal for a senior-level estimator with 20+ years of general estimating experience, including aviation and mega project exposure. The Senior Estimator will lead conceptual and detailed estimates, manage and mentor a team of estimators, and serve as a key liaison between project management, clients, and other stakeholders.

This is a full-time, on-site position, requiring a proactive, detail-oriented individual with a firm but respectful approach to estimate reconciliations and change order negotiations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop conceptual and detailed estimates across multiple scopes of work
  • Lead and manage estimating teams; train junior estimating staff
  • Review and assess cost proposals and change order requests for merit
  • Evaluate labor rates, markups, and productivity against contract standards
  • Verify material pricing using R.S. Means and other industry benchmarks
  • Interpret contract documents and modifications to define scope and cost implications
  • Reconcile estimates between contractors, internal teams, and third-party evaluators
  • Maintain consistent and clear estimate change reporting
  • Compile and analyze historical cost data for future use
  • Collaborate with project management and other departments to ensure alignment and accuracy

Requirements

  • Minimum 20 years of general estimating experience, with a focus on mega projects and aviation
  • Extensive knowledge of Progressive Design-Build and CMAR delivery methods
  • Proficiency with large-scale estimating software and industry tools
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex estimate reconciliations and change order negotiations
  • Strong leadership and mentoring capabilities
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills
  • Results-oriented with a self-starter attitude
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field
  • Strong command of various estimating software platforms and cost databases

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and performance-based incentives
  • Relocation package
  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Retirement plan options
  • Professional development and training opportunities
  • Exposure to high-impact, nationally recognized infrastructure projects
  • Collaborative, growth-oriented company culture

title: Product Designer Sênior
description:
O Grupo Ivy está contratando um Product Designer Sênior para atuar em um projeto estratégico de redesign de uma plataforma digital já consolidada no mercado .

O projeto será realizado em parceria com um cliente do Grupo Ivy que possui uma solução amplamente utilizada por profissionais do direito , especialmente advogados . O objetivo é conduzir um processo estruturado de redesign da experiência do produto , com forte foco em entendimento das dores dos usuários e evolução da plataforma.

Buscamos um profissional com perfil muito hands-on , capaz de atuar desde pesquisa com usuários até a definição de interfaces e estruturação de design system , contribuindo diretamente para a evolução do produto.

Responsabilidades

  • Conduzir entrevistas com clientes e usuários para mapeamento de dores, necessidades e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Apoiar na definição da experiência e evolução do produto digital .
  • Desenvolver fluxos, wireframes e interfaces com foco em usabilidade e eficiência.
  • Trabalhar no redesign da plataforma existente , respeitando o contexto de um produto já consolidado.
  • Estruturar e evoluir componentes e padrões de Design System .
  • Colaborar com times de produto e tecnologia durante o processo de construção.

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada como Product Designer em produtos digitais.
  • Experiência conduzindo entrevistas com usuários/clientes e mapeamento de dores.
  • Domínio de Figma .
  • Experiência em design de produtos digitais (UX + UI) .
  • Experiência na criação ou evolução de Design Systems .

Informações do projeto

  • Duração: 3 meses
  • Modelo de trabalho: Remoto
  • Modelo de contratação: PJ ou Cooperado
  • Início: Imediato

Interessado?

Se você tem experiência em Product Design e redesign de produtos digitais , gostaríamos de conhecer seu trabalho.

title: Senior Application Security Engineer
description:
One of the world's largest providers of products and services to the energy industry has a need to develop, support and integrate software system in Oil & Gas domain.

You will be a member of a cross functional team.

Key project stakeholders are open for innovative ideas.

Project is based on SCRUM methodology.

This is a great opportunity to work in an international team, apply and learn modern IT technologies


Responsibilities:

  • Application Security with strong AI/ML security exposure
  • Threat modeling and risk assessment for AI systems, APIs, and cloud-native applications
  • Protection against prompt injection, adversarial ML, data poisoning, and model abuse
  • Secure SDLC and CI/CD integration, including MLOps pipelines
  • Hands-on experience with SAST, DAST, SCA, container scanning, and security automation
  • Strong collaboration with development and data science teams



Mandatory Skills Description:

  • 5+ years in Application Security, with at least 1-2 years focused on AI/ML security
  • Strong secure coding and vulnerability management background (OWASP Top 10)
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS and/or Azure)
  • Strong programming skills in Python or Java
  • Familiarity with AI platforms such as Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, or Spark
  • Strong communication skills

Inicialmente é uma vaga temporária para reposição de uma pessoa que está de licença maternidade, mas pode extender após experiência.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada como SEO Analyst
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de SEO (Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, etc.)
  • Experiência com estratégias de SEO on-page e off-page
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e trabalho em equipe
  • Inglês e espanhol em nível avançado
  • Experiência com publicação e formatação de conteúdo em CMSs (Wordpress)


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com SEO técnico
  • Conhecimento em marketing de conteúdo e inbound marketing
  • Certificações em SEO
  • Conhecimento em HTML, CSS e práticas recomendadas de web development
  • Graduação em Marketing, Comunicação, TI ou áreas relacionadas


Responsabilidades:

  • Planejar, implementar e gerenciar estratégias de SEO
  • Realizar auditorias de SEO e fornecer recomendações detalhadas
  • Monitorar, analisar e relatar o desempenho de SEO
  • Realizar pesquisa de palavras-chave e análise de concorrentes
  • Otimizar o conteúdo do site para mecanismos de busca
  • Colaborar com equipes de desenvolvimento, conteúdo e marketing para garantir as melhores práticas de SEO
  • Ficar atualizado com as últimas tendências e mudanças no algoritmo dos motores de busca
  • Publicar e formatar conteúdo usando CMSs como o Worpdress e outros


Benefícios:

  • Trabalho 100% remoto
  • Horário semi-flexível
  • Oportunidade de trabalhar em projetos para grandes marcas globais
  • Ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e dinâmico
  • Desenvolvimento profissional contínuo


Se você é proativo, detalhista e está sempre em busca de melhorar a visibilidade e desempenho dos sites, envie seu currículo e junte-se a nós!


Como se candidatar: Candidate-se aqui por essa vaga no LinkedIn respondendo as perguntas de seleção.

title: Analista de Relações com Investidores e ESG III
description:
Descrição da vaga

A Helbor Empreendimentos S.A. é uma das incorporadoras mais tradicionais do mercado imobiliário brasileiro, com mais de quatro décadas de atuação. Companhia aberta listada no Novo Mercado da B3 , a Helbor tem como compromisso a transparência, a ética e a criação de valor sustentável para seus acionistas e para a sociedade.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista Sênior de Relações com Investidores e ESG para integrar nossa área de RI, atuando diretamente no suporte às atividades de comunicação com o mercado de capitais e no fortalecimento da agenda de sustentabilidade da companhia.

A área de Relações com Investidores possui papel estratégico na companhia, sendo responsável pela interface com investidores, analistas de mercado, órgãos reguladores e demais stakeholders, garantindo a qualidade, consistência e transparência das informações divulgadas ao mercado.

Buscamos um(a) profissional com perfil analítico, organizado(a), com excelente capacidade de comunicação e interesse em mercado de capitais e temas relacionados a ESG. A pessoa selecionada terá a oportunidade de atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, com alto nível de exposição a temas estratégicos da companhia e contato direto com diferentes áreas internas e participantes do mercado.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Apoiar a elaboração e revisão de materiais de divulgação ao mercado, como Release de Resultados, Apresentações Institucionais, Formulário de Referência e Relatórios Anuais;
  • Apoiar a preparação e organização de conference calls, reuniões com investidores, analistas e roadshows;
  • Interagir com diversas áreas internas (Contabilidade, Controladoria, Jurídico, Planejamento e Operações) para coleta e consolidação de informações para divulgação ao mercado;
  • Auxiliar no monitoramento de indicadores operacionais e financeiros da companhia e de seus pares;
  • Apoiar o acompanhamento de temas regulatórios relacionados ao mercado de capitais;
  • Participar da elaboração e acompanhamento de iniciativas relacionadas à agenda ESG;
  • Apoiar na elaboração de relatórios e questionários de sustentabilidade, bem como no relacionamento com agências de rating ESG;
  • Auxiliar no acompanhamento da percepção do mercado sobre a companhia e na elaboração de análises de mercado e benchmarking com empresas do setor;
  • Contribuir para o aprimoramento contínuo das práticas de transparência e governança da companhia.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação superior em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência prévia em Relações com Investidores, mercado de capitais, equity research, consultorias ou áreas financeiras;
  • Conhecimento sobre demonstrações financeiras e indicadores econômico-financeiros;
  • Familiaridade com rotinas de companhias abertas e regulamentação aplicável;
  • Interesse ou experiência com temas relacionados a ESG e sustentabilidade corporativa;
  • Inglês avançado (especialmente para leitura e comunicação escrita);
  • Excel e PowerPoint em nível avançado;
  • Perfil analítico, organizado, com atenção a detalhes e boa capacidade de comunicação escrita e verbal.

Informações adicionais

O que nós oferecemos:

  • Vale Alimentação
  • Vale Refeição
  • Assistência Médica
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Participação nos Resultados
  • Wellhub
  • Zenklub
  • Espaço de descompressão equipado com vídeo games, ping pong e espaço para alimentação

Onde estamos: Faria Lima - SP

title: Especialista em Microsoft Teams/Sharepoint
description:
A PSM Company é especializada na identificação de Talentos para as áreas de TI / Telecom como também para as áreas operacionais e administrativas. Nossa história de sucesso, está baseada em nosso modelo de negócios que proporcionam assertividade e qualidade no processo seletivo, baixo Turn Over e isenção de riscos e passivos trabalhistas.

O que Buscamos?

Especialista em Microsoft Teams/Sharepoint

Estamos buscando um especialista microsoft SharePoint, com especialização em Microsoft Teams.

Descrição:

  • Experiência mandatória com Workshop, Piloto, Ativação, Otimização do Teams e dos Aplicativos;
  • Experiência em funções voltadas ao cliente em arquitetura de sistemas, administração, operações, suporte de software e consultoria de TI, com foco em Microsoft Teams;
  • Experiência com soluções técnicas para tratar problemas dos clientes, garantindo desempenho e confiabilidade ideais do Microsoft Teams;
  • Vivência avançada em engenharia e design arquitetural de Comunicações Unificadas, com foco em Microsoft Teams, configurações de PSTN, Teams Enterprise Voice, Direct Routing e infraestrutura de telefonia (como Session Border Controllers e Contact Centers);
  • Auxiliar na implantação, configuração e personalização do Microsoft Teams e de aplicativos relacionados para atender às necessidades dos clientes;
  • Conhecimento técnico profundo da arquitetura, recursos e funcionalidades do Microsoft Teams;
  • Experiência avançada com implantação do SharePoint, OneDrive e Exchange;
  • Experiência com administração do Microsoft Teams, incluindo gerenciamento de usuários, políticas e conformidade;
  • Soluções relacionadas, como SharePoint, OneDrive, Power Platform, Azure AD, Intune e outros serviços do M365;
  • Experiência no desenho e na implementação de soluções de Telefonia do Teams, incluindo Direct Routing, Calling Plans, Phone System e Voice Apps, além de Microsoft Teams Room Systems e configurações de hardware relacionadas;
  • Forte conhecimento de protocolos, padrões e melhores práticas de voz e rede;
  • Forte capacidade de solucionar problemas de chamadas, conferências e qualidade de chamada no Microsoft Teams;
  • Conhecimento e experiência na criação de bot no Teams, integração do Microsoft Graph em um aplicativo do Teams e conhecimento das ferramentas usadas para desenvolver aplicativos do Teams. Conhecimento do Microsoft Teams Toolkit é um diferencial;

Certificações:

  • Microsoft Certified: Teams Administrator Associate ou outras certificações relevantes;
  • Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate;

Contratação CLT

Trabalho Hibrido - (Viagens exporaticas a nivel nacional)

O que oferecemos?

  • Vale Refeição ou Alimentação;
  • Assistência Médica e Assistência Odontológica;
  • Auxílio creche;
  • Convênio com Farmácia;
  • Parcerias com Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas;
  • Parceria de descontos com Seguro Auto e Residência;
  • Gympass;
  • Seguro de Vida;

Promovemos um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo e acolhedor. Não fazemos distinção por raça, cor, religião, gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, deficiência ou idade. Todas as candidaturas serão consideradas. O seu interesse em participar deste processo seletivo, automaticamente consente, autoriza e concorda que a PSM COMPANY, no papel de CONTROLADORA, tome decisões referentes ao tratamento de seus dados pessoais para esta finalidade específica, em conformidade com a Lei nº 13.709 – Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados Pessoais (LGPD).

title: Investment Banking Intern
description:
Investment Banking Internship - WSO Global Talent Program

Our Global Talent Program offers an unparalleled opportunity to gain hands-on experience and build a formidable resume through an immersive, 10-week virtual internship.


We are actively screening thousands of top students globally to identify future finance leaders. This highly selective program is offered in partnership with leading boutique investment banks in key markets, including the US, UK, APAC, Europe, MENA markets.


Only two students are selected per quarter for this off-cycle, ongoing program, ensuring a focused and high-impact experience for our interns per geographic region.


What You'll Gain:

  • Intensive Financial Training (Weeks 1-2): The internship kicks off with two weeks of rigorous, in-house virtual training led by industry experts. You'll gain a strong foundation in core investment banking skills, including:
  • 3-Statement Financial Modeling
  • Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Analysis
  • Trading Comparables (Comps)
  • Precedent Transactions
  • Advanced Excel & PowerPoint techniques
  • Industry Research & Sourcing Strategies
  • Real-World Experience (Weeks 3-10): Following successful completion of the initial training and assessments, you'll be introduced to a Managing Director or Partner at one of our boutique investment bank partners. For the next eight weeks, you'll work directly on live projects, providing invaluable support with:
  • Pitch Book Development
  • Valuation Analysis (Comps, DCFs)
  • Financial Modeling
  • Sourcing & Due Diligence
  • Industry and Company Research
  • And other critical tasks to support ongoing deals.
  • Mentorship & Feedback: Our partner firms are committed to providing a structured learning environment with a minimum of one 30-minute weekly call for deliverables, feedback, and guidance. This ensures you're actively engaged and continuously developing.


This is an unpaid internship designed for high-potential students seeking practical experience and a significant resume boost. The value lies in the rigorous training, direct exposure to real investment banking work, and the mentorship from experienced professionals.


Who We're Looking For:

This program is ideal for highly motivated 1st year and 2nd year students (not limited to) who are eager to get a head start in investment banking and build a compelling CV. We seek candidates who are hungry, quick learners, and committed to excelling in a fast-paced environment.


How to Apply:

Get your application in now! If selected, you will be invited to complete a short assessment. Top candidates from this assessment will move forward to the intensive training phase.

This is your chance to gain an unparalleled edge in your finance career. We look forward to reviewing your application!

title: GRC - Third Party Risk Specialist
description:
GRC - Third Party Risk Specialist – Remote

Location: Brazil


Job Description for Third Party Risk Specialist

Requirements


• 1-5 Years of Information Security Experience

• Speaks English, Spanish, and Portuguese

This role, part of the GRC (Governance, Risk, and Compliance) team in the Information Security Department, involves collaboration with Legal, Purchasing


Responsibilities include:


• Third-Party Risk Assessment: Conduct risk assessments of third-party vendors to ensure they meet security requirements and standards.

• NIST Attestation Review: Review and ensure compliance with NIST (National Institute of Standards and Technology) standards and attestations.

• Risk Communication: Communicate risk assessment findings to team owners, custodians of information risk, business partners, and information governance and security teams.

• Risk Management Advice: Provide advice to information governance or security teams to enable informed risk management decisions.

• Control Implementation: Identify and facilitate the implementation of appropriate controls to effectively manage information risks.

• Risk Posture Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve risk posture, develop solutions for remediating or mitigating risks, and assess residual risk.

• Relationship Management: Maintain strong working relationships with individuals and groups involved in managing information risks across the organization.


Key Qualifications


• Proven trustworthiness and history of acting with integrity, taking pride in work, seeking to excel, being curious and adaptable, and communicating well.

• Ability to identify and assess the severity and potential impact of risks, and communicate findings to risk owners outside the cybersecurity program to drive objective, fact-based decisions that optimize the trade-off between risk mitigation and business performance.

• Understanding of organizational mission, values, goals, and consistent application of this knowledge.

• Ability to work on several tasks simultaneously and pay attention to sources of information from inside and outside one’s network within an organization.

• Ability to apply original and innovative thinking to produce new ideas.

• Understanding of business needs and commitment to delivering high-quality, prompt, and efficient service to the business.

• Excellent prioritization capabilities, with an aptitude for breaking down work into manageable parts, effectively assessing the priority and time required to complete each part.

• Strong decision-making capabilities, with a proven ability to weigh the relative costs and benefits of potential actions and identify the most appropriate one.

• Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.

title: GRC - Third Party Risk Specialist
description:
GRC - Third Party Risk Specialist – Remote

Location: Brazil


Job Description for Third Party Risk Specialist

Requirements


• 1-5 Years of Information Security Experience

• Speaks English, Spanish, and Portuguese

This role, part of the GRC (Governance, Risk, and Compliance) team in the Information Security Department, involves collaboration with Legal, Purchasing


Responsibilities include:


• Third-Party Risk Assessment: Conduct risk assessments of third-party vendors to ensure they meet security requirements and standards.

• NIST Attestation Review: Review and ensure compliance with NIST (National Institute of Standards and Technology) standards and attestations.

• Risk Communication: Communicate risk assessment findings to team owners, custodians of information risk, business partners, and information governance and security teams.

• Risk Management Advice: Provide advice to information governance or security teams to enable informed risk management decisions.

• Control Implementation: Identify and facilitate the implementation of appropriate controls to effectively manage information risks.

• Risk Posture Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve risk posture, develop solutions for remediating or mitigating risks, and assess residual risk.

• Relationship Management: Maintain strong working relationships with individuals and groups involved in managing information risks across the organization.


Key Qualifications


• Proven trustworthiness and history of acting with integrity, taking pride in work, seeking to excel, being curious and adaptable, and communicating well.

• Ability to identify and assess the severity and potential impact of risks, and communicate findings to risk owners outside the cybersecurity program to drive objective, fact-based decisions that optimize the trade-off between risk mitigation and business performance.

• Understanding of organizational mission, values, goals, and consistent application of this knowledge.

• Ability to work on several tasks simultaneously and pay attention to sources of information from inside and outside one’s network within an organization.

• Ability to apply original and innovative thinking to produce new ideas.

• Understanding of business needs and commitment to delivering high-quality, prompt, and efficient service to the business.

• Excellent prioritization capabilities, with an aptitude for breaking down work into manageable parts, effectively assessing the priority and time required to complete each part.

• Strong decision-making capabilities, with a proven ability to weigh the relative costs and benefits of potential actions and identify the most appropriate one.

• Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.

title: Application Security Engineer
description:
Before you apply, please get familiar with Luxoft:

  • Luxoft locations:
  • Logeek Magazine:
  • Luxoft Alumni Club:

Mandatory Skills Description:

  • 5+ years in Application Security, with at least 1-2 years focused on AI/ML security
  • Strong secure coding and vulnerability management background (OWASP Top 10)
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS and/or Azure)
  • Strong programming skills in Python or Java
  • Familiarity with AI platforms such as Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, or Spark
  • Strong communication skills

Project Description:

  • One of the world's largest providers of products and services to the energy industry has a need to develop, support and integrate software system in Oil & Gas domain.
  • You will be a member of a cross functional team.
  • Key project stakeholders are open for innovative ideas.
  • Project is based on SCRUM methodology.
  • This is a great opportunity to work in an international team, apply and learn modern IT technologies

Responsibilities:

  • Application Security with strong AI/ML security exposure
  • Threat modeling and risk assessment for AI systems, APIs, and cloud-native applications
  • Protection against prompt injection, adversarial ML, data poisoning, and model abuse
  • Secure SDLC and CI/CD integration, including MLOps pipelines
  • Hands-on experience with SAST, DAST, SCA, container scanning, and security automation
  • Strong collaboration with development and data science teams

title: Senior Business Development Representative
description:
Salary: 24k - 36k / year + commissions

Full-time position.

Remote.


About UpstartAEC

UpstartAEC helps architecture, engineering, and construction firms scale smarter. We provide high-performing nearshore teams from Latin America through staff augmentation and managed services. Our clients increase capacity, reduce overhead, and protect margins without sacrificing quality.


We are growing quickly and looking for a driven outbound professional who knows how to open doors and generate real pipeline.


The Role

This is a high-performance outbound sales position focused on:

  • High-volume cold calling
  • Prospecting senior decision-makers
  • Generating qualified meetings
  • Driving pipeline for staff augmentation services


You will be on the phone daily. This role requires confidence, resilience, and strong communication skills. If you thrive in high-activity environments and are motivated by performance targets, this role is for you.


What You’ll Do

  • Execute high-volume outbound cold calling campaigns targeting the US market
  • Engage Directors of Operations, Project Managers, CEOs, COOs, and firm principals in AEC companies
  • Qualify prospects for staff augmentation opportunities
  • Book meetings for senior sales leadership
  • Follow structured outbound sequences (calls, LinkedIn, email)
  • Maintain CRM hygiene and track performance metrics
  • Handle objections professionally and move conversations forward
  • Meet and exceed weekly and monthly meeting targets


What We’re Looking For

  • Required 4+ years of experience in outbound sales
  • Proven experience with high-volume cold calling
  • Fluent, professional-level spoken and written English
  • Clear and confident communication skills for engaging US-based executives
  • Strong objection-handling abilities
  • Experience selling B2B services (staffing, outsourcing, tech, or professional services preferred)
  • Comfortable speaking with senior-level decision-makers
  • Self-motivated, organized, and performance-driven
  • Experience selling into US-based companies


Profile We Value

  • Results-oriented and accountable
  • Strong resilience and professionalism
  • Structured and metrics-driven
  • Comfortable in a performance-based culture
  • Motivated by growth and earning potential


Why Join UpstartAEC?

  • Fast-growing company in a specialized niche
  • Clear value proposition: cost savings + capacity expansion
  • Selling into real business challenges (backlogs, hiring constraints)
  • Direct exposure to leadership
  • Performance is recognized and rewarded

title: Senior Quality Assurance Automation Engineer
description:
Own your future

Our culture isn’t something people join, it’s something they build and shape. We believe that every person deserves to be heard and empowered. If you’re on the fence about whether you’re a fit, we say go for it. Let’s build something great together.


Must haves

  • TypeScript proficiency (3+ years)
  • Proficiency with Playwright
  • Experience with Vitest or Jest
  • Experience with React Testing Library
  • Understanding of Page Object Model
  • Experience with REST/RPC API testing
  • Experience with Git and GitHub Actions
  • Experience with monorepo architecture (PNPM workspaces, Turborepo)
  • SQL / database testing fundamentals
  • Upper-intermediate or advanced English, daily communication with US-team members


Nice to have

  • Experience with tRPC
  • Drizzle ORM or similar TypeScript ORM experience
  • Experience with microfrontend architecture
  • Storybook / visual regression testing
  • Accessibility testing automation (axe-core, Playwright accessibility)
  • Experience setting up coverage thresholds and quality gates in CI
  • Familiarity with Zustand and TanStack Query


Key responsibilities

  • Build out and maintain the Playwright E2E test framework (page objects, fixtures, test data management)

title: Software Architect (.NET)
description:
Somos a Vortigo - nascemos com o propósito de criar aplicativos mobile para um mundo em constante movimento, mas não paramos por aí. Ampliamos nossa atuação e hoje desenvolvemos softwares para ajudar empresas e startups no processo de transformação digital.

Nosso time é composto por pessoas apaixonadas por desafios gigantes, mudando a experiência dos usuários a nível global.

Estamos espalhados pelo Brasil e pelo mundo, tocando projetos nacionais e internacionais.

Nosso ambiente é descontraído, com uma cultura horizontal, muita troca de conhecimento, reconhecimento e desafios! Tá afim de fazer parte de tudo isso?

Dá uma olhada no que estamos buscando:

Principais Responsabilidades:

- Pesquisar, testar e engajar a adoção e disseminação de novas tecnologias e padrões de solução;

- Colaborar no desenho e implementação de soluções estratégicas para o negócio;

- Participar no desenvolvimento de novos produtos;

- Participar no desenvolvimento de projetos de APIs;

- Definir métodos de integração entre sistemas legados e novos projetos;

- Apoiar no desenvolvimento técnico dos demais integrantes da equipe.

Habilidades Técnicas:

- Experiência sólida em arquitetura de software (Clean Architecture, Domain Driven Design, Microsserviços, Component Driven Design, etc.);

- Domínio de práticas DevOps e CI/CD, com pipelines automatizados para back, front e mobile (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Bitrise, App Center);

- Vivência com Cloud (Azure, AWS ou GCP) e provisionamento de infraestrutura como código (IaC);

- Conhecimento em desenvolvimento nativo e multiplataforma (Kotlin, Swift, Flutter, React Native) e web (React.js, Angular, Next.js);

- Experiência em .NET e desenvolvimento backend escalável, com padrões arquiteturais e mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka);

- Capacidade de aplicar padrões e boas práticas de engenharia de software (SOLID, Design Patterns, Clean Code);

- Experiência com contêineres e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes);

- Conhecimento em testes automatizados e estratégias de qualidade (unitários, instrumentados, end-to-end, testes de performance);

- Vivência com monitoramento e observabilidade de sistemas (Application Insights, Jaeger, Firebase Crashlytics, Sentry);

- Conhecimento em segurança de aplicações (OWASP, autenticação multifator, antifraude, segurança mobile/web);

- Atuação com sistemas distribuídos e integração com APIs REST/GraphQL;

- Habilidade em liderar decisões técnicas, avaliar riscos e suportar múltiplas squads em ambientes ágeis.

O que você encontra aqui:

Remote First – Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar.

Comunidades Técnicas – Um espaço para galera trocar uma ideia, conversar sobre algum assunto específico e, claro, muita troca de conhecimentos.

Cultura de Feedback – Feedbacks estruturados periodicamente, buscando o desenvolvimento contínuo através de um Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI).

Horário Flexível - Autonomia para fazer a sua própria gestão da jornada de trabalho.

Incentivo ao Idioma - Temos como objetivo internacionalizar cada vez mais a Vortigo e você será parte disso!

Gympass - Plataforma focada na saúde e bem-estar corporativo.

Reembolso de Equipamentos – Valor semestral de reembolso para compra de equipamentos que facilitam sua rotina de trabalho em casa.

title: Trilingual Junior Administrative Assistant (English, Spanish, Portuguese)
description:
A US-based law firm is looking for a proactive and detail-oriented trilingual Junior Administrative Assistant to join our team remotely as a contractor (third-party service provider).

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • Fluency in English, Spanish and Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Intake and sales skills.
  • Customer service skills.
  • Proficiency in Canva is desirable.
  • Strong analytical skills with great attention to detail.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
  • Excellent organizational, time management, and multitasking abilities.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • A collaborative, teamwork-oriented mindset with a strong sense of empathy.
  • Problem-solving skills and the ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities:

  • Engage with leads and clients, offering translation and interpreting services as needed.
  • Schedule consultations with leads and potential clients.
  • General customer service tasks.
  • Provide front desk assistance.
  • General administrative support across departments (administrative, legal, and marketing).
  • Assist with various tasks within the administrative department.
  • Create and present reports to guide decision-making.

Technical requirements:

  • Reliable home office setup, including appropriate hardware, software, and high-speed internet.
  • Licensed Microsoft Office software and up-to-date antivirus protection.

* Only selected applicants will be contacted.

** Please submit your resume in English.

title: Senior Architect
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Senior Architect .


In this role you will:

Lead architecture and delivery of systems that unify OT and IT across SCADA/MES and enterprise platforms. Apply UNS (ISA‑95/88), govern industrial data models, and enable secure, scalable batch/streaming integrations on‑prem and in the cloud.

  • Architect and design end‑to‑end OT→IT data integrations (batch/streaming) from SCADA, MES, Historians to enterprise/cloud (Azure/AWS/GCP); Experience in Azure Event Hubs/Event Grid is a plus.
  • Apply UNS (ISA‑95/88), industrial data modeling, and metadata management; enforce data quality, lineage, governance, and security-by-design.
  • Integrate industrial platforms (Ignition, HiveMQ, HighByte advantageous) via OPC UA, MQTT, BACnet, Modbus; build/govern RESTful APIs and connectors for SAP, SCADA, MES, LIMS, Historians.
  • Define and socialize application/integration/infrastructure standards, lead architecture for enterprise IT and digital transformation in regulated manufacturing.
  • Deploy/support enterprise applications with reliability, compliance, and operability, design for scalability, resilience, and cost efficiency.
  • Perform schema design and performance tuning across SQL/NoSQL datastores.
  • Produce and maintain clear architecture artifacts (diagrams, process/sequence flows, specifications); provide guidance to cross‑functional delivery teams.


We have some requirements:

  • Bachelor’s in engineering, Instrumentation & Control, Computer Science, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience in manufacturing or life sciences with OT/IT interoperability; familiarity with GxP, regulated data flows, and enterprise data governance is advantageous.
  • Strong analytical/problem‑solving; structured troubleshooting.
  • Clear communicator with effective stakeholder management across technical and business teams.
  • Proactive, detail‑oriented collaborator in agile, cross‑functional environments.
  • Strong analytical/problem‑solving; structured troubleshooting.
  • Clear communicator with effective stakeholder management across technical and business teams.
  • Fluent English

title: Analista de negócios sênior (ArcGIS)
description:
Estamos procurando um profissional com capacidade de realizar a análise de negócios, na área de Recursos Nauturais, orientando a equipe no desenvolvimento e/ou manutenção de soluções de GIS/TI nas fases de Design, Construção, Tecnologia, Requisitos, Teste, Infraestrutura, Configuração e Qualidade.


Formação:

  • Superior completo em Ciências Exatas, da Terra e afins.


Habilidades Técnicas:

  • Conhecimento do sistema ArcGIS;
  • Conhecimento de SIG;
  • Conhecimento em TI/infraestrutura;
  • Capacidade de análise crítica de especificações de sistemas e negócios;
  • Capacidade de aferir a qualidade da entrega através de testes.


Habilidades Desejáveis:

  • Conceito de Sensoriamento Remoto
  • Conhecimento na área de Recursos Naturais (preferencialmente mineração e/ou meio ambiente);
  • Capacidade de elaborar Plano de Teste e Caderno/Procedimento de Testes;
  • Conhecimento de DevOps;
  • Certificações;
  • Especializações/Mestrado;
  • Inglês Avançado.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Interpretar documentação e informações de negócio compreendendo processos de negócio mapeados e contribuindo para a definição da arquitetura e implementação da solução e ao atendimento das necessidades de negócio existentes.
  • Criar documentação de usuário e administração de sistemas desenvolvidos garantindo o registro do processo e práticas utilizadas.
  • Conduzir processos de Discovery
  • Realizar o levantamento dos requisitos da aplicação
  • Orientar a análise, modelagem e documentação de requisitos funcionais e não funcionais.
  • Disseminar o entendimento sobre os processos de negócio necessários à implementação da solução, assimilando e orientando o uso de conceitos e vocabulário próprio das áreas de negócio envolvidas no projeto.
  • Capacidade de análise crítica de especificações de sistemas e negócios.
  • Capacidade de aferir a qualidade da entrega através de testes.
  • Capacidade de elaborar Plano de Teste e Caderno/Procedimento de Testes de alta complexidade.
  • Avaliar e selecionar as opções da plataforma ESRI que melhor atendam uma respectiva solução.


Por que escolher a Geosistemas?


Saúde e Bem-Estar:

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico - Sul América.
  • ✅ Seguro de Vida e Acidentes Pessoais.
  • ️ ♂️ Acesso ao Gympass para cuidar do corpo e da mente.

title: Shopify E-Commerce Specialist - Remote - USD compensation
description:
About Staff4Half & Our Client

Staff4Half specializes in providing high-quality virtual specialists to help businesses supercharge their productivity. We offer tailored solutions across various domains, empowering companies to achieve their goals efficiently and effectively through customized support.

We are currently partnering with a fast-growing, Direct-to-Consumer (D2C) e-commerce brand to find a dedicated E-Commerce Specialist. In this role, you will work directly with our client's team to drive tangible results, manage their digital storefront, and maximize sales opportunities.


Key Responsibilities
  • Shopify & Product Management: Execute directions from the E-commerce Manager to update pricing, add new products, and maintain the homepage, collections, and product pages. Build and maintain landing pages, optimize listings for SEO and sales, and manage apps that enhance the customer experience.
  • Merchandising & Website Optimization: Follow merchandising strategies to highlight key products and promotions. Build campaign-specific landing pages, troubleshoot site issues, and strategically utilize apps to boost conversion rates.
  • Email & SMS Marketing (Klaviyo): Execute email and SMS campaigns and flows. Segment audiences, monitor performance metrics, and rigorously test formatting, deliverability, and links.
  • SEO & Site Performance: Support ongoing SEO initiatives, including keyword implementation, on-page optimization, content updates, and basic technical SEO. Monitor site performance using analytics tools and recommend improvements to drive organic traffic.
  • General Support & Reporting: Execute tasks according to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), clearly communicate progress or roadblocks, identify opportunities to increase sales, and collaborate closely with the design and customer service teams.
  • Ad Hoc Requests: Handle additional E-commerce and D2C operational tasks as directed to support the overall growth of the brand.
Qualifications

Core Requirements:

  • Experience: 1+ years of proven experience working in a fast-paced Shopify environment.
  • Technical Platforms: Hands-on experience with Shopify (adding products, managing collections, landing pages, and apps) and Klaviyo or similar platforms (email/SMS campaigns, segmentation, flows, and A/B testing).
  • Analytical Skills: Strong ability to assess data, monitor performance, and identify concrete growth opportunities.
  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication, alongside great customer service skills to ensure positive interactions with stakeholders.
  • Mindset: Proactive problem-solver with a positive, can-do attitude, strong initiative, and excellent follow-through. Ability to follow strategic direction and execute tasks accurately.

Bonus Points (Nice-to-Have):

  • Familiarity with analytics platforms like GA4, Google Search Console, Commission Junction, and Google Analytics.
  • Understanding of e-commerce best practices, including SEO and site optimization.
  • Experience with specific Shopify apps like Timesact Pre-order, Conjured Memberships, heat map tools, and quiz apps (we are happy to train the right person on these!).
What We Offer
  • Compensation: Competitive salary rate in USD (Semi-Senior level).
  • Work Setup: 100% Fully Remote Contractor role.
  • Time Off: 12 days of paid time off (PTO) plus holidays.
  • Growth: Yearly salary revisions based on performance.

We are currently partnering with a fast-growing, Direct-to-Consumer (D2C) e-commerce brand to find a dedicated E-Commerce Specialist. In this role, you will work directly with our client's team to drive tangible results, manage their digital storefront, and maximize sales opportunities.


Key Responsibilities
  • Shopify & Product Management: Execute directions from the E-commerce Manager to update pricing, add new products, and maintain the homepage, collections, and product pages. Build and maintain landing pages, optimize listings for SEO and sales, and manage apps that enhance the customer experience.
  • Merchandising & Website Optimization: Follow merchandising strategies to highlight key products and promotions. Build campaign-specific landing pages, troubleshoot site issues, and strategically utilize apps to boost conversion rates.
  • Email & SMS Marketing (Klaviyo): Execute email and SMS campaigns and flows. Segment audiences, monitor performance metrics, and rigorously test formatting, deliverability, and links.
  • SEO & Site Performance: Support ongoing SEO initiatives, including keyword implementation, on-page optimization, content updates, and basic technical SEO. Monitor site performance using analytics tools and recommend improvements to drive organic traffic.
  • General Support & Reporting: Execute tasks according to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), clearly communicate progress or roadblocks, identify opportunities to increase sales, and collaborate closely with the design and customer service teams.
  • Ad Hoc Requests: Handle additional E-commerce and D2C operational tasks as directed to support the overall growth of the brand.
Qualifications

Core Requirements:

  • Experience: 1+ years of proven experience working in a fast-paced Shopify environment.
  • Technical Platforms: Hands-on experience with Shopify (adding products, managing collections, landing pages, and apps) and Klaviyo or similar platforms (email/SMS campaigns, segmentation, flows, and A/B testing).
  • Analytical Skills: Strong ability to assess data, monitor performance, and identify concrete growth opportunities.
  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication, alongside great customer service skills to ensure positive interactions with stakeholders.
  • Mindset: Proactive problem-solver with a positive, can-do attitude, strong initiative, and excellent follow-through. Ability to follow strategic direction and execute tasks accurately.

Bonus Points (Nice-to-Have):

  • Familiarity with analytics platforms like GA4, Google Search Console, Commission Junction, and Google Analytics.
  • Understanding of e-commerce best practices, including SEO and site optimization.
  • Experience with specific Shopify apps like Timesact Pre-order, Conjured Memberships, heat map tools, and quiz apps (we are happy to train the right person on these!).
What We Offer
  • Compensation: Competitive salary rate in USD (Semi-Senior level).
  • Work Setup: 100% Fully Remote Contractor role.
  • Time Off: 12 days of paid time off (PTO) plus holidays.
  • Growth: Yearly salary revisions based on performance.

title: Software Engineer
description:
We are looking for a highly skilled Software Engineer to join our team. You will primarily be utilizing .NET Core, C#, SQL. We hire innovative software development professionals who can work well within a highly collaborative, agile team to develop high quality, testable software. Ideally, you will have a wide breadth of experience performing development in a .NET environment and developing integrations to third-party systems.


Responsibilities:

  • Developing SaaS applications, including .NET APIs, and React applications
  • Working with our product organization to understand business requirements and objectives
  • Contributing to overall system architecture strategy and design
  • Leading by example and setting a high standard for code quality
  • Performing code and design reviews
  • Motivating an agile team and fostering collaboration and innovation across our development organization


Qualifications:

  • Minimum 5 years full-stack experience working through design, implementation, testing, and delivering high availability enterprise applications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or 4-6 years of related experience
  • Should have a record of successful delivery of software applications as an individual and with a team
  • Strong understanding of the Agile software development methodologies and principles
  • Experience with CI/CD
  • Must have strong experience and exhibit in-depth knowledge of .NET Core, C#, SQL, MVC, SOA, Web API, Microservices, JavaScript, Typescript, HTML
  • Frontend experience is a plus (Angular, React)
  • Understanding of cloud native applications (Azure, AWS)

title: Artificial Intelligence Specialist
description:
About the company:

Our Client is a globally distributed team focused on developing advanced AI-driven systems. They are dedicated to creating agentic platforms utilizing cutting-edge AI technologies. With a flexible and remote-friendly work environment, their team collaborates across multiple continents.

Job Description:

Our Client is seeking a skilled AI Developer to join their innovative team. The ideal candidate will have experience in building AI agents and platforms, working with Django or Node, and a strong understanding of various AI functionalities.

Responsibilities of the role:

• Develop and implement AI-driven systems and platforms. • Collaborate with project managers, CTO, and CIO to ensure project alignment. • Participate in daily and weekly team meetings. • Work asynchronously using Slack and Linear for communication. • Meet project deadlines and deliver high-quality results.

Required Experience and Qualifications:

• Senior or upper medium level experience in AI development. • Strong knowledge of AI systems, including building and implementing AI agents. • Proficiency in Django, Node, or both. • Experience working with LLMs and agent systems. • Excellent English communication skills.

Preferred Skills:

• Familiarity with remote work tools such as Slack, Linear, and GitHub. • Experience with multimodal systems. • Ability to work independently and manage time effectively.

Personality:

• Strong communication skills and ability to participate in team meetings. • Self-motivated and able to work independently. • Open to working in a flexible schedule, including weekends if necessary.

Software & Tools

• Slack • Linear • GitHub • Django • Node

English Level:

C1, C2.

Schedule:

9 to 5 EST

title: SAP S4HANA FICO Consultant
description:
Job Title: SAP S4HANA FICO Consultant

Location: Brazil, Remote Hybrid as applicable

Role Summary

We are looking for an experienced SAP S4HANA FICO AMS Consultant to provide L2 and L3 application support for Finance processes with a strong focus on FI modules. The role involves production support, incident and problem management, minor enhancements, and close collaboration with business stakeholders, especially during month-end close activities, where CO and Material Ledger support is critical

The ideal candidate demonstrates strong ownership, structured problem-solving, clear communication, and execution rigor in a run-and-maintain environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • AMS Production Support L2 L3
  • Provide L2L3 functional support for SAP S4HANA FI processes, including incident, problem, and service request management.
  • Perform root cause analysis RCA for recurring issues and drive permanent corrective actions.
  • Ensure compliance with SLAOLA targets and operational KPIs
  • Handle critical finance incidents, coordinating with technical teams and providing timely stakeholder updates
  • Support month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close, including extended support where required
  • Functional Scope FI CO
  • Strong hands-on support experience in
  • FIGL FIAP FIAR
  • Asset Accounting FIAA
  • Bank Accounting Electronic Bank Statements
  • Brazil localization taxes, legal reporting, country-specific requirements
  • CO support primarily during the month-end close with focus on
  • Material Ledger
  • Cost Center and Profit Center Accounting
  • Period-end allocations and settlements
  • Deep understanding of FIMM and FISD integrations, especially finance postings from logistics processes
  • Enhancements Change Support
  • Deliver minor enhancements and configuration changes within the AMS scope
  • Prepare functional specifications, test cases, and support UAT activities
  • Participate in change and release management processes
  • Maintain high-quality functional and operational documentation
  • Soft Skills Behavioral Expectations
  • Accountability takes end-to-end ownership of issues through resolution
  • Communication Clear, concise, and proactive communication with business and IT stakeholders
  • Rigor, discipline, structured analysis attention to detail, and auditready documentation
  • Collaboration works effectively across teams, vendors and time zones
  • Customer Focus Understands business impact and prioritizes work accordingly

Experience Qualifications

  • 7 to 10 years of relevant SAP FICO experience
  • Strong experience in SAP S4HANA AMS Production Support
  • CO knowledge is required especially for monthend close and Material Ledger activities
  • Experience working with ITSM tools such as ServiceNow
  • Bachelor's degree in finance, Accounting Information Systems or related field or equivalent experience
  • SAP S4HANA Finance certification is a plus

title: Product Designer (Foco UI) - Sênior
description:
Estamos em busca de um Product Designer com foco em UI para atuar no desenvolvimento de produtos digitais em um ambiente colaborativo e orientado a dados.

Essa posição é ideal para profissionais que gostam de trabalhar próximos aos times de Produto e Engenharia , contribuindo para a construção de experiências consistentes, escaláveis e bem estruturadas para plataformas digitais.

Buscamos alguém com atenção aos detalhes, organização e capacidade de atuar em um ambiente ágil e dinâmico , participando ativamente de decisões de design e da evolução de sistemas e produtos digitais.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Criar interfaces de alta fidelidade , garantindo consistência visual, usabilidade e qualidade na experiência do usuário.
  • Desenvolver wireframes, fluxos de navegação e protótipos , colaborando com Product Managers e outros stakeholders.
  • Garantir a qualidade das entregas de design, realizando validações antes e depois da implementação .
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de Produto e Engenharia em ciclos ágeis de desenvolvimento.
  • Organizar arquivos, fluxos e componentes de forma estruturada.
  • Contribuir para a evolução do Design System e boas práticas de design dentro do time.
  • Participar da melhoria contínua de processos, fluxos de trabalho e padrões de design.


Requisitos

  • Forte experiência em design de produtos digitais (UX/UI) .
  • Forte domínio de UI Design , com atenção a detalhes visuais, consistência e acessibilidade.
  • Experiência na criação de wireframes, protótipos e fluxos de usuário .
  • Vivência em colaboração com Product Managers e times de engenharia .
  • Experiência com design systems e componentização de interfaces .
  • Conhecimento de boas práticas de UX e testes de usabilidade .
  • Domínio do Figma , incluindo protótipos interativos e componentes reutilizáveis.
  • Inglês fluente , necessário para interação com times internacionais.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com Design Ops .
  • Familiaridade com conceitos técnicos que facilitem a comunicação com desenvolvedores (APIs, JSON etc.).
  • Experiência com produtos baseados em dados ou inteligência artificial .
  • Experiência em plataformas B2B ou softwares corporativos .
  • Vivência em times multidisciplinares .
  • Espanhol.


O que oferecemos

  • Modelo de contratação PJ.
  • Remoto.
  • Descanso remunerado.
  • Equipamentos.

title: Data Pipeline Engineer Sr / OT-IT Integration
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for a Data Pipeline Engineer Sr / OT–IT Integration .

In this role you will:

Design, build, and operate resilient OT-IT data pipelines across SCADA/MES and enterprise systems. Apply UNS (ISA 95/88), model/govern industrial data, and deliver secure batch and streaming integrations on prem and in the cloud.

  • End to end pipelines: Design, implement, and operate batch/streaming flows from SCADA, MES, and Historians to cloud/enterprise (Azure/AWS/GCP); Experience in Azure Event Hubs/Event Grid is plus.
  • UNS & modeling: Apply UNS (ISA 95/88), data modeling, and metadata management; ensure data quality, lineage, and governance.
  • Industrial integration: Connect (Ignition, HighByte, HiveMQ advantageous) using OPC UA, MQTT, BACnet, Modbus; build/consume RESTful APIs and connectors for SCADA, MES, LIMS, Historians.
  • Design schemas and tune performance across SQL and NoSQL stores.
  • Security & reliability: implement authN/authZ best practices; Design for scalability, resilience, and cost efficiency.
  • Dev practices: use Git/GitHub (branching, reviews, releases) and create clear architecture diagrams, process flows, and specifications.

We have some requirements:

  • Bachelors in engineering, Instrumentation & Control, Computer Science, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience in manufacturing or life sciences with OT/IT interoperability; familiarity with GxP, regulated data flows, and enterprise data governance is a plus.
  • Strong analytical/problem solving with structured troubleshooting.
  • Clear communication and stakeholder management across technical and business teams.
  • Fluent English

title: Tech Lead Fullstack
description:
Descrição da vaga

A Verity está buscando novos talentos!

Somos uma aceleradora de soluções digitais e buscamos Fullstack Tech Lead (React e Java) para fazer parte dessa jornada.

Olha só quais são as experiências e conhecimentos que você precisa ter para acelerar e transformar com a gente:

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Liderar tecnicamente o desenvolvimento e evolução de um novo produto de agendamento e roteirização, garantindo coerência entre frontend (React), backend (Java) e integrações em ambiente GCP.

Atuar na definição da arquitetura técnica da solução, estabelecendo padrões de desenvolvimento, versionamento de APIs e uso de mensageria baseada em eventos (Pub/Sub).

Trabalhar em conjunto com as áreas de Produto, Arquitetura e Dados para traduzir direcionadores estratégicos em soluções técnicas escaláveis e sustentáveis.

Apoiar a construção da base tecnológica do produto, incluindo estrutura de autenticação, controle de acesso, contratos de APIs e integração entre serviços.

Participar ativamente do planejamento técnico das entregas, contribuindo com estimativas, definição de abordagem técnica e organização do backlog técnico.

Responsabilidades :

Garantir alinhamento técnico entre frontend e backend, assegurando contratos de APIs estáveis, integração consistente e redução de retrabalho.

Definir e disseminar boas práticas de arquitetura orientada a serviços, versionamento de APIs e comunicação baseada em eventos.

Revisar e validar decisões críticas de arquitetura, prevenindo acoplamentos indevidos e riscos de regressão operacional.

Conduzir code reviews estruturados, promovendo qualidade, segurança e consistência no código desenvolvido pela squad.

Antecipar riscos técnicos, gargalos arquiteturais e impactos sistêmicos, propondo estratégias de mitigação.

Garantir níveis adequados de observabilidade, resiliência e performance ponta a ponta (frontend + backend).

Apoiar a evolução do modelo de dados e integração com arquitetura de dados corporativa, garantindo escalabilidade e governança técnica.

Documentar decisões arquiteturais e padrões adotados, assegurando continuidade e sustentabilidade do produto.

Requisitos e qualificações

Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento backend com Java e construção de APIs REST.

Experiência prática com React e arquitetura de aplicações frontend modernas.

Experiência em arquitetura de sistemas distribuídos e arquitetura orientada a serviços.

Conhecimento em integração baseada em eventos (ex.: Pub/Sub, mensageria ou streaming).

Experiência em ambientes cloud, preferencialmente Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

Vivência em liderança técnica de squads ágeis e condução de code reviews.

Experiência com práticas de engenharia modernas: CI/CD, versionamento de APIs, observabilidade e testes automatizados.

Capacidade de análise arquitetural e tomada de decisão técnica em ambientes críticos e de alta escala.

Diferenciais, não obrigatórios:

Experiência em projetos de plataformas de agendamento, logística ou roteirização.

Conhecimento em modelagem de domínio e Domain-Driven Design (DDD).

Experiência com arquiteturas baseadas em event-driven architecture.

Vivência em projetos de transformação digital ou modernização de sistemas legados.

Experiência com estratégias de escalabilidade, resiliência e observabilidade em sistemas críticos.

Familiaridade com práticas de engenharia assistida por IA.

Informações adicionais

Aqui nós somos humanos, somos digitais, somos Verity!

Tudo o que fazemos se baseia em nossos 8 POWER PRINCIPLES:

  • Amar tecnologia;
  • Assumir grandes responsabilidades;
  • Cultivar relações de confiança por meio da transparência;
  • Dar atenção e ser orientado pela necessidade e experiência do cliente;
  • Encarar desafios de forma ágil;
  • Colaborar entre pessoas e equipes;
  • Encorajar a autonomia consciente;
  • Atingir resultados de forma consciente.

É assim que criamos experiências inovadoras para o mundo digital, inspirando protagonismo e gerando resultados incríveis aos nossos clientes, sempre focados em metodologia, tecnologia e pessoas.

Fomos certificados como uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar pelo Great Place To Work, e a cada dia criamos ações que melhoram ainda mais o ambiente de trabalho, aqui na Verity você tem:

  • Vale refeição
  • Vale alimentação
  • Auxílio home office
  • Assistência médica
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Seguro de vida
  • Parcerias de descontos
  • Convênios em estabelecimentos e instituições de ensino
  • Treinamentos de agilidade recorrentes
  • Verity Learning
  • Intervalo Verity
  • #VerityComVocê

E aí, topa criar experiências inovadoras para o mundo digital?

Etapas do processo

  • Etapa 1: Cadastro 1 Cadastro
  • Etapa 2: Entrevista RH 2 Entrevista RH
  • Etapa 3: Entrevista Tech 3 Entrevista Tech
  • Etapa 4: Entrevista Final 4 Entrevista Final
  • Etapa 5: Processo de Contratação 5 Processo de Contratação
  • Etapa 6: Contratação 6 Contratação

Somos uma consultoria de Transformação e Engenharia Digital_

A Verity é uma consultoria de Transformação e Engenharia Digital.

Estruturamos tecnologia para funcionar, escalar e gerar valor real. Atuamos na Modernização de Aplicações, decisões críticas de Arquitetura, Engenharia de Software e Dados, Experiência Digital e orquestração de processos com Inteligência Artificial.

Com o Verity Quantum®, nosso orquestrador de IA, conectamos engenharia, plataformas e operações para modernizar legados, otimizar código e acelerar decisões com impacto direto no negócio.

Há 16 anos, trabalhamos ao lado de mais de 100 empresas líderes em seus mercados, nos setores financeiro, saúde, varejo, indústria e serviços, transformando estratégia em soluções tecnológicas que geram eficiência, escala e vantagem competitiva.

Desde 2019, somos certificados como Great Place to Work - GPTW, reconhecimento que reforça nossa cultura baseada em transparência, confiança e compromisso real com a entrega.

title: Analista de Processos (Pl)
description:
Somos protagonistas na transformação digital dos meios de pagamento, somos a HST!

Desvendamos os desafios mais complexos e desde a nossa fundação temos a missão de tornar as transações eletrônicas mais seguras.


Estamos presentes em +20 Países e, dentre os nossos Clientes, estão os 8 Bancos mais importantes do Brasil e os 20 da América Latina!


São +80.000 terminais de autoatendimento; +1.000.000 autenticações de transações de compras eletrônicas ao mês; +800.000 cartões bancários com chip disponibilizados ao mês em lojas e agências bancárias; e só em 2021, foram +50 bancos utilizando nossa wallet digital e sistemas de emissor que permitem a tokenização de cartões Cof (Card on File) e eCommerce. Isso é só uma parte dos nossos resultados, mas também é só começo!


Nos bastidores de todas as nossas conquistas está o nosso Time, que conta com +200 Pessoas envolvidas no desenvolvimento das nossas soluções. Pessoas questionadoras, curiosas, criativas, proativas, colaborativas e abertas a novas experiências!

Para saber mais sobre a HST e sobre as nossas oportunidades, acesse:


Buscamos uma pessoa Analista de Processos (Pleno) para se unir ao nosso Time de Strategy para:

  • Mapear, analisar e padronizar processos com visão AS IS / TO BE;
  • Conduzir entrevistas e levantar requisitos operacionais com as áreas;
  • Elaborar e manter fluxos, POPs, SOPs, RACI, checklists e critérios de aceite;
  • Publicar e versionar documentos em Confluence, SharePoint e Jira;
  • Gerir backlog de melhorias de processos e apoiar a priorização com as áreas;
  • Acompanhar indicadores operacionais de processo e propor melhorias;
  • Garantir rastreabilidade, aderência aos padrões e suporte a auditorias/compliance;
  • Apoiar a disseminação de boas práticas e orientar perfis mais juniores na qualidade das entregas.


Acreditamos ser importante que você já tenha passado por algumas experiências e que também tenha os seguintes conhecimentos:

  • Experiência com Jira, Confluence e SharePoint/OneDrive para documentação, publicação, versionamento e rastreabilidade;
  • Experiência com mapeamento e modelagem de processos em BPMN, AS IS e TO BE;
  • Conhecimento em Bizagi Modeler, Visio ou draw.io;
  • Excel intermediário para consolidações e análises operacionais;
  • Noções práticas de Lean, ITIL, BPM/CBPP, critérios de aceite e controle de versão;
  • Capacidade de identificar gargalos, retrabalho, desvios e oportunidades de padronização.


Será um grande diferencial se:

  • Experiência com melhoria contínua e workflow;
  • Conhecimento em indicadores de processo como lead time, retrabalho, aderência e eficiência;
  • Certificações como Lean Six Sigma, ITIL Foundation e CBPP;
  • Espanhol e Inglês para leitura e trocas simples;
  • Conhecimento do negócio de meios de pagamento como diferencial.


O que oferecemos?

A HST é uma empresa certificada GPTW! Oferecemos a oportunidade de crescimento em um ambiente de desafios em que a contrapartida de cada Pessoa equivale ao tamanho da sua vontade de crescer !

  • Contratações em regime CLT;
  • Horário flexível;
  • Oportunidade de crescimento, através do contínuo desenvolvimento, tanto técnico quanto pessoal;
  • Temos programas de desenvolvimento destinado às novas lideranças;
  • 10% das horas mensais, podem ser dedicadas para aprender algo novo;
  • Day-Off no mês do aniversário;
  • Ajuda de Custo Home Office;
  • Pluxe Cuida – Programa de Assistência à Pessoa Colaboradora;
  • Licença Maternidade e Paternidade Ampliadas;
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
  • WellHub (antiga Gympass);
  • Convênio médico;
  • Convênio odontológico;
  • Vale Alimentação/Refeição;
  • Vale Transporte ou estacionamento;
  • Auxílio Creche;
  • Seguro de Vida.


Prezamos por um bom ambiente de trabalho que contribua para as pessoas evoluírem e se sentirem acolhidas, livres, autênticas e à vontade para demonstrarem suas habilidades! Apoiamos a diversidade e não temos espaço para qualquer tipo de discriminação!

title: VMWare VCF Consultant (REMOTE)
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a VMWare Cloud Engineer expert in Cloud Formation to work remotely for a client in the US.


The VCF expert will design, deploy, and support modern VMware infrastructure. This role focuses on building stable, scalable environments using vSphere, vSAN, NSX, and SRM, while enabling hybrid‑cloud capabilities.


Job location: Remote, work from home, anywhere in Brazil.


MUST BE fluent in English. All interviews will be in English only.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Deploy and manage VCF, including management and workload domains.
  • Implement and optimize vSphere, vSAN, NSX‑T, HCX, and SRM.
  • Troubleshoot issues across compute, storage, and network virtualization.
  • Perform capacity planning, health checks, and risk assessments.
  • Produce documentation and operational handoff materials.
  • Support DR architecture and testing.
  • Provide knowledge transfer to customers and internal teams.



Requirements

  • 10+ years of IT experience
  • MUST BE fluent in English
  • MUST BE an expert in VMWare Cloud Foundation
  • Experience with VCF or large‑scale VMware deployments.
  • Strong understanding of virtualization, networking, and storage.
  • Hands‑on with at least two: vSAN, NSX‑T, HCX, SRM.
  • Familiarity with HCI platforms (e.g. Dell VxRail).
  • Strong troubleshooting and communication skills.

Preferred

  • VMware certifications (VCP/VCAP/VCIX).
  • Experience with automation (PowerCLI, Ansible, Terraform).
  • Exposure to AWS/Azure/GCP and hybrid integrations.
  • Knowledge of backup/storage platforms like PowerStore or Veeam.
  • Previous experience in Consulting and/or client facing roles

title: Back-end / Platform Engineer
description:
Job Title: Back-end / Platform Engineer

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Contract Type: Contract


Key Responsibilities


• Design, develop, and maintain data-driven APIs using GraphQL and REST.

• Build and optimize backend services interacting with relational and NoSQL databases.

• Design and manage GraphQL schemas, resolvers, and API performance.

• Implement API security, versioning, and governance best practices.

• Deploy and manage services using container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.

• Work with cloud platforms (AWS or OCI) to build scalable and reliable systems.

• Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize application and database performance.

• Participate in architecture discussions and contribute to system design decisions.

• Mentor junior engineers and promote best practices within the engineering team.


Required Skills & Experience


• 6+ years of software engineering or backend development experience.

• Strong experience with API development (GraphQL and REST).

• Solid understanding of database design and optimization (SQL & NoSQL).

• Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS or OCI).

• Experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).

• Proficiency in at least one backend language: Node.js, Java (Spring Boot), or Python.

• Strong problem-solving skills and ability to design scalable systems.

• Familiarity with API security, versioning, and monitoring tools.

• Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate in a distributed team environment.

title: Backend Engineer Python-DevOps
description:
We are looking for a Backend Engineer with strong DevOps capabilities to support a team focused on improving customer operations through technology and data insights.

In this role, you will work closely with an external vendor building AI-assisted evaluation workflows that analyze customer interactions. You’ll help enable these systems by building supporting backend services, enabling data access and mining, and establishing the infrastructure required for them to operate effectively.

Your work will involve containerized services, AWS Lambda, Terraform-managed infrastructure, and secure data transfer between AWS accounts.

You will collaborate with engineering, product, and operational teams, while also coordinating technical requirements with the vendor. Strong communication skills are important, as you’ll often act as the bridge between the vendor and internal teams, helping translate requirements, manage requests, and ensure the implementation aligns with internal technical standards.

What we’re looking for:

● Strong Python backend development experience

● Solid AWS and DevOps experience

● Experience with containerized services

● Familiarity with Terraform and infrastructure as code

● Experience working with AWS Lambda and cloud-based services

● Ability to work independently while collaborating with multiple stakeholders

● Strong communication and coordination skills

Nice to have:

● Familiarity with TypeScript or Node.js

● Interest in AI-driven workflows

This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy working across development and infrastructure, enabling data-driven systems, and collaborating across teams to deliver impactful solutions.

Join Our Global Team: We invite you to apply for the position at RE Partners. Join us in shaping the future of business technology consulting and transforming the way organizations thrive in a digital world. As a diverse, woman-owned global business, we pride ourselves on keeping talent happy – our 7% attrition rate speaks volumes. Bring your talented friends along and earn a referral bonus

Equal Opportunity Employer: We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status.
